title: Who do you vibe code/make these games for? Learning material at work?
author: RossRiskDabbler
selftext:
At my work, I've build a small vibe coding "online multiplayer" race game with a few people, just for fun sake. To let other coworkers also get acquainted with what AI can do instead of big 4 giving a course on what AI can do (coding/charts etc). 

I see people here mostly bitch about either use of AI for commercial sale, or they hate it general. I'm not pro/against it, but I do think it's taught perhaps very theoretical in large corporations.  

Most of us work in large firms, whats the problem of showing internally what AI can do for games among coworkers as it shows them easier ways to learn AI/gaming functionality etc?

This isn't about beauty, it's about solving problems. Assume a race game, can you model on paper/AI/through Matlab a way to do a pitstop. That way of thinking.
